_comment: D-COST-4 (#193): in-character DM lines shown when a turn's review cannot settle. Each admits the slip and asks the player to restate; none may claim anything happened. Nothing in the game changes on these turns.
lines: I wasn't able to do that, let's try again. What were you thinking?
Sorry, I was distracted by my pet dragon. Say that again?
Hold on, I lost my place in my notes. What did you want to do?
My dice rolled off the table and I missed that. Run it by me once more?
Forgive me, my mind wandered to the next chapter. What was your move?
I got that a little tangled. Tell me again what you'd like to do?
Apologies, a gust blew my map off the table. Where were we? What are you trying?
I didn't quite catch that one. Could you say it again, maybe one step at a time?
